note: Reproduced the exact missing-Instabox error; the message gives no recovery and the failed attempt leaves a registration.

findings.criterion: connect --persist with Instabox missing leaves a saved entry
findings.description: Run `connect coordinator <mp> --sandbox m_7f3a1234 --root /workspace/project --persist` with no instabox, then run it again.
findings.expected: First failure rolls back, or says the definition was saved and what to do; rerun works or points to `mounts forget`.
findings.actual: First run: "Could not find an executable Instabox CLI in PATH or ~/.local/bin." `mounts list` then shows the entry registered. Rerun: "A mount named 'coordinator' is already registered." with no hint to run `mounts forget coordinator`. Foreground connect failure (no Finder app) does roll back, so behavior is inconsistent.
findings.suggested_fix: Roll back the registration when the service cannot start, or append 'Run agent-drive mounts forget coordinator to retry.'

findings.description: Search docs and CLI help for what Instabox is and how to install it.
findings.expected: The missing-Instabox error says what it is and where to get it.
findings.actual: The error has no install hint or link; docs/cli and --help use the word without defining it; the message names only PATH and ~/.local/bin.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an install link to the message and one docs sentence.
